parsed.explanation: Traveler-facing exposure is high: national border screening ties entry to birth-sex passport markers, can refuse or demand more evidence and, if deemed wilful misrepresentation, threatens permanent fraud ineligibility; some travelers report stranding. Federal and state policies restrict government facilities by birth sex; this state reaches public schools/government buildings, uses complaint reporting, and its documentary defense generally unavailable to foreign-document visitors, creating universal exclusion/humiliation. If detained, federal/state custody reports severe sexual abuse, forced labour, and conversion-style practices. Public accommodation and hotel protections are absent, while hate-crime/equality machinery is partial and unproven for visitors. No execution or routine arrest for identity is documented, and some state protections exist, so not severe-risk extreme; but current unremedied state restrictions push High Risk.
